comparison.rule: Two configurations differ on a measure only if their three per-seed values do not overlap: every seed of one is strictly better than every seed of the other (final return: lowest of one above highest of the other; steps to 150 and wall-clock: slowest of one below fastest of the other). A seed that never reaches 150 counts as slower than any seed that does; two seeds that never reach it are tied. Equal endpoints count as overlap. Anything else is cannot tell.
